I am getting old, and farming alone without my husband is hard. This wheat plot is small but important for our household — wheat brings a good price and we eat injera and bread from it. I will buy some fertilizer from the cooperative because wheat needs it to give a real harvest, but I cannot afford the full package they recommend. I will use the seed I saved from last year like I always do, and my children will help me with weeding and harvest so I do not need to pay much hired labor.
